blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The third status conference before the International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III may be the first time former President Rodrigo Duterte will personally appear before the court to face charges of crimes against humanity. This is because, unlike in previous court proceedings, no waiver of appearance has been made public ahead of the hearing. Duterte has yet to appear before the tribunal in person, with his last “appearance” taking place on March 14, 2025, when he joined the proceedings via video conference.
